response.sql: SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The count is the number of matched (advancedbehavior, transactionrecord) row pairs per translink and ordertypedist combination, and the fraction denominator is the sum of those counts across all combinations sharing the same ordertypedist, computed after the peercorr filter and join.
Ties in the fraction are broken arbitrarily since no secondary sort was requested.
